articles.title: NASA+ Content Coming to Big Screen at Greenbelt, Maryland Cinema
articles.snippet: NASA announced Monday that NASA+ content has found its first theatrical home at The Greenbelt Cinema in Greenbelt, Maryland, expanding the agency’s reach across major viewing platforms and bringing space even closer to home. “The National Aeronautics and...
articles.summary: NASA announced on Monday that NASA+ content is coming to the big screen at The Greenbelt Cinema in Greenbelt, Maryland. This is the first theater for NASA+, helping the agency reach more viewing platforms and bring space closer to home.

articles.title: Teams Lock in Mission Architecture for NASA’s SR-1 Freedom
articles.snippet: NASA completed a major review for Space Reactor-1 (SR-1) Freedom and locked in key elements of the spacecraft, which is targeted to launch in 2028 and demonstrate nuclear electric propulsion in deep space for the first time.  Experts from across the...
articles.summary: NASA finished a big review and locked in key parts of its Space Reactor-1 Freedom spacecraft. It is planned to launch in 2028 to demonstrate nuclear electric propulsion in deep space for the first time.

articles.title: Amateur Astronomer? Be a Kilonova Catcher!
articles.snippet: Neutron stars are the ultra-dense, city-sized leftovers of dead stars.  When they collide, they can release a brief flash of light called a kilonova.

articles.title: NASA’s Northrop Grumman CRS-25 Mission Overview
articles.snippet: NASA’s Northrop Grumman Commercial Resupply Services 25 mission, or Northrop Grumman CRS-25, will deliver about 11,000 pounds of science and supplies to the International Space Station.  The mission will be the third flight of the company’s Cygnus XL, the...
articles.summary: NASA’s Northrop Grumman CRS-25 mission will deliver about 11,000 pounds of science and supplies to the International Space Station. This mission will be the third flight of Northrop Grumman’s Cygnus XL.

articles.title: Webb Reveals New Details in Supernova Remnant
articles.snippet: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope reveals the hot dust that makes up Cassiopeia A (Cas A) in this high-resolution, mid-infrared image released on Nov.  23, 2026.
articles.summary: On November 23, 2026, NASA released a very clear picture from the James Webb Space Telescope. The image shows new details about the hot dust that makes up a supernova remnant called Cassiopeia A.

articles.title: NASA’s Titan-Bound Dragonfly Rotorcraft Gets Its Eyes
articles.snippet: Science instruments for NASA’s Dragonfly are starting to arrive at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) in Laurel, Maryland, where the car-sized rotorcraft is coming together for its mission to explore Saturn’s largest moon, Titan. First to...
articles.summary: Science tools for NASA’s car-sized Dragonfly craft are starting to arrive at a lab in Maryland. It is being put together there for a mission to explore Titan, which is Saturn’s largest moon.

articles.title: NASA Hubble’s New View of NGC 4394 Raises the Bar
articles.snippet: The brilliant galaxy NGC 4394 with its distinct galactic bar takes center stage in this Hubble Space Telescope image
articles.summary: A new picture from NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope shows a bright galaxy called NGC 4394. This galaxy is the main focus of the image and has a clear galactic bar.

articles.title: Meet the first new living cat species described in more than a century
articles.snippet: Genetic tests on two of these teeny tiger cats, found in Bolivia, show they constitute a new species. They add a new branch to the feline family tree.
articles.summary: Genetic tests on two tiny tiger cats found in Bolivia show they are a new species. They are the first new living cat species described in more than 100 years, adding a new branch to the cat family tree.

articles.title: Hydrogels could help stop wildfires from reigniting, teens find
articles.snippet: The brothers custom built a nozzle to spray their fire-retardant hydrogels up to 60 feet.
articles.summary: Teen brothers found that hydrogels could help stop wildfires from starting again. They built their own nozzle to spray their fire-blocking hydrogels up to 60 feet.

articles.title: Eruption Extends Iwo Jima’s Beach
articles.snippet: A volcanic eruption just off the southeast shore of the Pacific island has reshaped the coast, but it’s unclear how long the new land will survive.
articles.summary: A volcanic eruption near the southeast shore of the Pacific island Iwo Jima has extended its beach and reshaped the coast. However, it is not clear how long this new land will survive.
